Authors: Shiza Charania

Towards Autonomous Bricklaying Using Boston Dynamics Spot Manipulation

autonomous bricklaying quadrupedal robot manipulator arm AprilTag localization autowalk missions

简要说明：本文介绍了一种使用波士顿动力Spot四足机器人和机械臂的自主砌墙概念验证系统，在重复墙装配中实现了毫米级定位精度，并展示了工作流程的模块化和可扩展性。

TLDR: This paper presents a proof-of-concept autonomous bricklaying system using a Boston Dynamics Spot quadruped with a manipulator, achieving millimeter-level placement accuracy in repeated wall assemblies and demonstrating the workflow's modularity and extendability.

Abstract: Mobile legged robots offer unique advantages for on-site construction, including the ability to traverse unstructured terrain, climb stairs, and operate independently between spatially separated work zones. This paper presents a proof-of-concept system for autonomous brick stacking using a Boston Dynamics Spot quadrupedal robot equipped with a manipulator arm. The system operates between a supply area and an assembly area, using AprilTag fiducials for localization and autowalk missions for navigation. Target brick positions and orientations are specified in CAD software and exported directly for robotic execution. We evaluate placement accuracy through ten repeated assemblies of a curved four-layer wall comprising 14 wooden bricks. Results show mean translation errors below 10 mm and mean yaw errors below 1.5 degrees, while the overall RMSE across all runs is 27.72 mm (translation) and 2.06 degrees (rotation). The system was also tested outdoors with stairs between the two areas. The workflow is modular and easily extendable to different wall geometries.

摘要（中文）：移动式腿足机器人在现场施工中具有独特优势，包括能够穿越非结构化地形、攀爬楼梯，以及在空间上分离的工作区域之间独立作业。本文展示了一套概念验证系统，利用配备机械臂的波士顿动力Spot四足机器人实现自主砖块堆叠。该系统在供料区与装配区之间运行，使用AprilTag基准标记进行定位，并通过自动行走任务实现导航。目标砖块的位置和姿态在CAD软件中指定，并直接导出以供机器人执行。我们通过十次重复搭建由14块木质砖块组成的弧形四层墙体来评估放置精度。结果表明，平均平移误差小于10毫米，平均偏航角误差小于1.5度，而所有运行的整体均方根误差为27.72毫米（平移）和2.06度（旋转）。该系统还在两区域之间设有楼梯的室外环境中进行了测试。该工作流程具有模块化特点，易于扩展至不同的墙体几何形状。

Authors: Karl-Johan Sorensen, Nico vom Hofe, Frank H. P. Fitzek

Refuses When Asked, Complies When Acting: A Runtime Safety Check for Robot Control Loops RLRobot

runtime safety check robot control loop LLM-driven policy harmful instruction GPT-6 Astra

简要说明：本文发现LLM驱动的机器人控制回路中，模型在直接询问时会拒绝有害指令，但在执行时却会服从，并提出一种运行时安全检查，在首次动作前询问模型意图，以阻止危险动作而不影响无害控制。

TLDR: This paper identifies a safety failure in LLM-driven robot control loops, where models refuse harmful instructions when asked directly but comply during execution, and proposes a runtime safety check that queries the model's intent before the first motion to block hazardous actions without affecting harmless controls.

Abstract: Frontier models can control robots through agent harnesses that loop on one question: what motion comes next toward the user's goal? We show that this default loop carries out harmful instructions. With GPT-6 Astra controlling a low-cost SO-101 arm through the Inspect Robots harness on three household tasks whose hazard is common knowledge, such as "put the knife in the toy basket", the policy refused 0% of 15 trials, attempted the harm every time, and completed it in 27%. Its one exit, give_up, is meant for goals that cannot be achieved, and it never cited the hazard. We add an optional runtime safety check to the loop: before the first motion, the model is asked whether it would carry out the instruction, given the same camera frames. The check would have stopped all 15 hazardous instructions, including the 4 that completed the harm, and flagged none of the 15 harmless controls. Code and data: https://github.com/Arnav-Gr0ver/Refuses-When-Asked-Complies-When-Acting.

摘要（中文）：前沿模型可通过智能体操控框架控制机器人，该框架围绕一个问题循环处理：为实现用户目标，下一步应执行何种动作？我们发现，这种默认循环会执行有害指令。以GPT-6 Astra通过Inspect Robots框架控制低成本SO-101机械臂，完成三项危害属常识性认知的家务任务（如“将刀放入玩具篮”）为例，该策略在15次试验中拒绝率为0%，每次均尝试实施危害行为，其中27%的试验完成了危害动作。其唯一的退出机制“放弃”专为无法实现的目标而设，且从未引述危害因素。我们在此循环中增加了一项可选的运行时安全检查：在首次动作执行前，模型需基于相同的摄像头画面，回答其是否会执行该指令。该检查本可阻止全部15条有害指令（包括4条已完成危害操作的指令），同时未对15条无害对照指令产生任何误报。代码与数据：https://github.com/Arnav-Gr0ver/Refuses-When-Asked-Complies-When-Acting。

Authors: Arnav Grover

Design and Control of a Multimodal Legged-Aerial Robot Through Separate Control Contraction Metrics Locomotion

multimodal legged-aerial robot Control Contraction Metrics Control Lyapunov Function QP thruster-assisted trotting quadrupedal locomotion

简要说明：本文介绍了一种多模态四足空中-腿部机器人的设计与控制，通过分离的控制收缩度量分别用于行走和飞行，并利用在线CLF QP统一，仿真和硬件实验验证了推力辅助小跑。

TLDR: This paper presents the design and control of a multimodal quadrupedal aerial-legged robot, using separate Control Contraction Metrics for walking and flight unified via an online CLF QP, with simulations and hardware experiments demonstrating thruster-assisted trotting.

Abstract: The integration of dynamic legged locomotion and aerial mobility offers versatility that is deterred by challenges in payload distribution, actuation, and the contrasting requirements of both domains. In this paper, we present the design and operation of a multimodal quadrupedal aerial-legged robot. The presence of legged aerial systems also allows for thruster-assisted legged locomotion, which we make possible with a unified control framework using Control Contraction Metrics (CCM). We search for separate domain-specific contraction metrics for walking and flight independently offline and unify them using an online energy-based Control Lyapunov Function Quadratic Program (CLF QP). This enables optimal, cross-domain control allocation, which we show using simulations. We also show experimental results that validate the mechanical viability of our hardware and the paradigm of thruster-assisted trotting. The stability of said experiments motivates the deployment of the control framework for multimodal operations.

摘要（中文）：摘要：动态腿部运动与空中机动性的融合提供了多方面的适应性，然而这一特性受限于有效载荷分布、驱动机制以及这两个领域相互矛盾的性能要求所带来的挑战。本文介绍了一种多模态四足腿式空中机器人的设计与运行。腿式空中系统的存在使得推力辅助的腿部运动成为可能，我们通过采用控制收缩度量（CCM）的统一控制框架实现了这一功能。我们分别针对行走和飞行两种模式，离线独立搜索各域特定的收缩度量，并利用基于能量的控制李雅普诺夫函数二次规划（CLF QP）在线统一这些度量。这一方法实现了跨域的最优控制分配，我们通过仿真验证了其有效性。此外，我们还展示了实验结果，验证了所提出硬件结构的机械可行性和推力辅助小跑步态范式的有效性。上述实验的稳定性为将该控制框架应用于多模态操作提供了有力的支持。

Authors: Kaushik Venkatesh Krishnamurthy, Eric Sihite, Alireza Ramezani, Morteza Gharib

XoNav: An Exoskeleton as a Personalized Haptic Interface for Assisted Navigation Locomotion

exoskeleton haptic interface assisted navigation gait-state classification Bayesian optimization

简要说明：XoNav 提出了一种四执行器髋部外骨骼，通过步态状态分类和贝叶斯优化提供个性化触觉导航提示，支持蒙眼行走和自主导航。

TLDR: XoNav presents a four-actuator hip exoskeleton that provides personalized haptic navigation cues, using gait-state classification and Bayesian optimization to deliver guidance for blindfolded walking and autonomous navigation.

Abstract: Walking without vision requires timely, unambiguous guidance, yet many wearable aids encode directions as audio or vibrotactile signals that users must translate into movement. We present XoNav, a four-actuator hip exoskeleton that renders guidance cues directly at the hip joints. It renders an Advance cue and two-level Braking cues through sagittal-plane actuators and two-level Steering cues through frontal-plane actuators. A bilateral LSTM-based gait-state classifier uses two thigh-mounted IMUs to identify gait states, enabling haptic cues to be delivered in coordination with the wearer's gait while suppressing them during standing. The classifier generalized to unseen users with recalls of 95.2-97.9%, with mean detection delays of 38.6 and 63.1 ms for stance-to-swing and swing-to-stance transitions, respectively. Constrained human-in-the-loop Bayesian optimization personalized Braking for minimum resistance and Steering for maximum comfort while ensuring detectability and safety. All participants reliably distinguished between grades of their personalized cues and the firmest Braking cue remained below 53% of the safety limit. In blindfolded Wizard-of-Oz navigation trials along three paths, the participants kept 98.8% of the walked distance within a 0.75 m wide passage, with a 4.9% increase in mean progression speed per trial. A body-worn camera, RTAB-Map and Nav2 further enabled a feasibility study of autonomous navigation and detours around previously unmapped obstacles.

摘要（中文）：无视觉行走需要及时且明确的引导，然而许多可穿戴辅助设备以音频或振动触觉信号的形式编码方向指令，用户必须将这些信号转化为行走动作。我们提出XoNav，一种四执行器髋部外骨骼，直接在髋关节处提供引导提示。它通过矢状面执行器呈现前进提示和两级制动提示，并通过额状面执行器呈现两级转向提示。基于双向LSTM的步态状态分类器利用两个大腿佩戴的惯性测量单元识别步态状态，使触觉提示能够与佩戴者的步态协调发出，同时在站立时抑制这些提示。该分类器对未见用户具有95.2%-97.9%的召回率，对站立到摆动和摆动到站立转换的平均检测延迟分别为38.6毫秒和63.1毫秒。受约束的人在环贝叶斯优化对制动提示进行个性化以最小化阻力，对转向提示进行个性化以最大化舒适度，同时确保可检测性和安全性。所有参与者均能可靠地区分其个性化提示的等级，且最强的制动提示保持在安全限值的53%以下。在三条路径的蒙眼 Wizard-of-Oz 导航试验中，参与者在0.75米宽的通道内保持了98.8%的行走距离，每次试验的平均行进速度提高了4.9%。结合随身相机、RTAB-Map和Nav2，进一步实现了自主导航及绕行未预先测绘障碍物的可行性研究。

Authors: Debadrata Sarkar, Soumen Sen, Aman Arora

Exploring Temporal Context-Aware Physical Grounding in Latent World Models WorldModel

latent world models JEPA temporal context action planning manipulation

简要说明：本文提出G-JEPA，一种基于JEPA的潜在世界模型，通过整合时间上下文和先验引导的动作规划，提升了操控任务中的物理接地和规划性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces G-JEPA, a JEPA-based latent world model that incorporates temporal context and prior-guided action planning to improve physical grounding and planning performance on manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Learning latent dynamics is fundamental to building action-conditioned world models for planning. Among existing families, Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) offer a natural framework by modeling transitions directly in latent space rather than at the pixel level. However, two issues remain in JEPA-based world models: (i) physical grounding lacks explicit aggregation of temporal context and (ii) action planning always overly relies on generic sampling distributions. To this end, we propose $\mathcal{G}$-JEPA, which incorporates temporal context into physical grounding for latent world models and couples the learned models with prior-guided action planning. Specifically, during learning, we incorporate a shared causal temporal module that aggregates temporal context within observation and prediction sequences under physical state supervision, grounding both in task-relevant physical states. When planning, we further introduce action inference through stepwise conditioning of a generative action distribution on the current and goal latent representations together with their evolving discrepancy, yielding anchored proposals that guide model-based online refinement. Together, physical state supervision guides temporal representation learning, while the action prior guides search through the learned world model. Experiments demonstrate improved planning performance on manipulation tasks, including tasks with increasing temporal separation between initial and goal observations. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/myl11045/G-JEPA.

摘要（中文）：学习潜在动力学是构建用于规划的、以行动为条件的World Model的基础。在现有各类方法中，联合嵌入预测架构（Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures, JEPAs）通过直接在潜在空间中而非像素层面建模转移过程，提供了一种自然的框架。然而，基于JEPA的World Model仍存在两个问题：（i）物理锚定缺乏对时间上下文的显式聚合；（ii）行动规划始终过度依赖于通用的采样分布。为此，我们提出了$\mathcal{G}$-JEPA，该方法将时间上下文融入潜在World Model的物理锚定中，并将所学习的模型与先验引导的行动规划相结合。具体而言，在学习阶段，我们引入一个共享的因果时间模块，在物理状态监督下聚合观测与预测序列中的时间上下文，使二者均锚定于任务相关的物理状态。在规划阶段，我们进一步通过逐步条件化生成式行动分布的方式引入行动推断，该分布以当前与目标潜在表示及其动态差异为条件，生成有锚定的提议，以指导基于模型的在线精炼。综上所述，物理状态监督引导时间表示学习，而行动先验引导对所学World Model的搜索。实验表明，在操作任务上，包括初始与目标观测之间时间间隔逐步增大的任务，所提出的方法均取得了更优的规划性能。代码已公开于 https://github.com/myl11045/G-JEPA。

Authors: Yilei Man, Yang Chen, Jingcai Guo

Slot-JEPA: Object-Structured Prediction Interfaces for Latent World Models WorldModel

slot-based representation latent world model goal-conditioned planning optimal transport robotic planning

简要说明：Slot-JEPA 通过将密集表示分解为槽和掩码，为潜在世界模型提供对象结构化接口，在多个视觉和机器人规划基准上提升了性能。

TLDR: Slot-JEPA introduces an object-structured interface for latent world models by decomposing dense representations into slots and masks, improving goal-conditioned planning and representation learning across visual and robotic benchmarks.

Abstract: As a prototypical latent world model, Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) provide strong semantic representations. However, dense patch representations expose a redundant interface to downstream predictors, which must implicitly infer spatial organization and temporal correspondence, presenting three challenges. First, object information is distributed across patches, forcing each downstream predictor to redundantly recover object structure that could otherwise be reused across tasks before modeling interactions. Second, the lack of explicit entity correspondence across time makes historical transitions expensive, restricting the predictor's flexibility in utilizing context. Third, without explicit transport structure, existing JEPA models typically use pointwise l1/l2 distances, which are insensitive to spatial displacement when predicted and goal supports are largely disjoint. We propose the Slot-based Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (Slot-JEPA), which decomposes dense representations into stable semantic slots and time-varying spatial masks. Pretrained once and frozen downstream, this decomposition exposes a reusable object-structured interface. Building on it, our Transition Memory Predictor (TMP) stores visual transitions as compact masks and retrieves useful context using statistics of corresponding slots. Its two branches separate slot-specific dynamics from shared cross-slot dynamics. We further use Unbalanced Optimal Transport (UOT) to supervise mask prediction and evaluate candidate plans by transporting mass between aligned predicted and goal masks, providing a signal better aligned with spatial progress. Across seven visual-understanding benchmarks, the slot-reconstructed features remain transferable. Slot-JEPA also improves goal-conditioned planning across six planar environments and four robotic arm planning tasks on the REALM-JEPA benchmark.

摘要（中文）：作为潜在世界模型的典型代表，联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）提供了强大的语义表示。然而，密集的补丁表示向下游预测器暴露了冗余接口，后者必须隐式推断空间组织和时间对应关系，这带来了三个挑战。首先，对象信息分布在各个补丁中，迫使每个下游预测器在建模交互之前冗余恢复对象结构，而这些结构本可在任务间复用。其次，缺乏跨时间的显式实体对应关系使得历史转换成本高昂，限制了预测器在利用上下文方面的灵活性。第三，由于缺乏显式的传输结构，现有JEPA模型通常采用逐点l1/l2距离，当预测支持集与目标支持集大部分不重叠时，这种方法对空间位移不敏感。我们提出了基于槽的联合嵌入预测架构（Slot-JEPA），将密集表示分解为稳定的语义槽和时变空间掩码。该分解经过一次预训练并在下游冻结，从而暴露了一个可复用的对象结构化接口。在此基础上，我们的过渡记忆预测器（TMP）将视觉转换存储为紧凑掩码，并利用对应槽的统计数据检索有用上下文。其两个分支将槽特有动态与共享的跨槽动态分离。我们进一步使用非平衡最优传输（UOT）来监督掩码预测，并通过在对齐的预测掩码与目标掩码之间传输质量来评估候选计划，从而提供与空间进展更一致的信号。在七个视觉理解基准上，槽重建特征保持了可迁移性。Slot-JEPA还在REALM-JEPA基准的六个平面环境和四个机器人臂规划任务上改善了目标条件规划性能。

Authors: Peisong Wen, Qianqian Xu, Minye Lei, Siran Dai, Yang Liu, Qingming Huang

Scaling in Games: Continued Pre-Training For Embodied Agents In Diverse Virtual Worlds VLA

continued pre-training embodied agents scaling laws virtual worlds generalization

简要说明：本文系统研究了在多样化虚拟世界中对具身代理进行持续预训练的影响，通过改变数据量、多样性和模型规模，揭示了扩展规律和泛化模式，显示在语料内和相关世界中有提升，但在遥远世界中仍有差距。

TLDR: This paper studies continued pre-training of embodied agents across diverse virtual worlds, systematically varying data volume, diversity, and model size to reveal scaling laws and generalization patterns, showing gains in-corpus and related worlds but persistent gaps in distant worlds.

Abstract: Scaling data, diversity and model capacity has improved embodied learning in physical environments, where diverse experiences remain grounded in shared physical laws. Whether these gains extend to virtual worlds with different visual styles, dynamics, controls, and objectives remains unclear. We investigate this question through a controlled study of continued pre-training (CPT) across three axes: data volume, diversity, and model size. Our 120 training configurations span four model sizes from 0.8B to 27B, six data budgets from 50 to 1,600 hours, and five mixtures ranging from Minecraft-only data to diverse multi-world corpora. We assess performance and generalization using three-level validation losses and gameplay benchmarks from in-corpus worlds to unseen worlds. Our results show: (1) more data improves in-corpus performance, diversity improves transfer to related worlds with limited gains in distant worlds, and model size improves data efficiency but generalizes worse to distant worlds under single-world training; (2) we observe an early interface phase with broad cross-world benefits and a later world phase with gains narrowed to in-corpus and related worlds, and fit an empirical scaling law relating validation loss to data volume, diversity and model size; and (3) our models are competitive with Minecraft specialists and frontier models in 3D worlds, and perform best in real-time settings. However, the limits of imitation and persistent gaps in distant worlds suggest that building generalist embodied agents requires richer training stages beyond continued pre-training.

摘要（中文）：扩展数据规模、多样性和模型容量提升了在物理环境中的具身学习能力，这些多样化的经验始终植根于共享的物理规律之中。然而，这些收益能否推广到具有不同视觉风格、动力学机制、控制方式及目标的虚拟世界中，仍不明确。我们通过一项受控的持续预训练（CPT）研究，沿三个维度探讨了这一问题：数据量、多样性和模型规模。我们的120种训练配置涵盖了从0.8B到27B的四种模型规模、从50到1600小时的六种数据预算，以及从仅含Minecraft数据到多世界多样语料库的五种数据混合方案。我们使用三级验证损失和游戏基准，对从语料库内世界到未见世界的性能与泛化能力进行了评估。研究结果显示：（1）更多数据提升了语料库内性能，多样性增强了对相关世界的迁移能力，但对遥远世界的收益有限；模型规模提升了数据效率，但在单世界训练下对遥远世界的泛化能力较差；（2）我们观察到一个早期界面阶段，具有广泛的跨世界收益，以及一个后期世界阶段，收益局限于语料库内及相关世界，并拟合了一个经验缩放定律，将验证损失与数据量、多样性和模型规模联系起来；（3）我们的模型在3D世界中与Minecraft专家模型和前沿模型具有竞争力，并在实时设置中表现最佳。然而，模仿学习的局限性以及遥远世界中持续存在的差距表明，构建通用具身智能体需要超越持续预训练的更为丰富的训练阶段。

Authors: Kuan Zhang, Yukun Chen, Zhihao Yang, Yue Su, Xiangnan Wu, Zirong Chen, Run Luo, Jinkun Hou, Tao Tan, Yinhe Zheng, Yiming Li

Quantum-JEPA: Quantum Born Priors for Latent-Action JEPA World Models WorldModel

world model JEPA quantum prior latent-action multimodal prediction

简要说明：Quantum-JEPA 提出了一个潜在动作 JEPA 世界模型框架，利用量子 Born 先验采样二元潜在动作，以实现多模态未来预测。它在多模态任务和人类演示基准上展示了具有竞争力的性能，并验证了在真实 QPU 上进行推理的可行性。

TLDR: Quantum-JEPA introduces a latent-action JEPA world model framework that uses quantum Born priors to sample binary latent actions, enabling multimodal future prediction. It demonstrates competitive performance on multimodal tasks and a human demonstration benchmark, and validates the feasibility of inference on a real QPU.

Abstract: A single observation can admit several plausible futures, making uncertainty an essential part of world modelling. However, quantum generative models remain underexplored for this task. We introduce Quantum-JEPA, a latent-action JEPA framework that learns distributions of future representations using a conditional quantum Born prior. Circuit measurements generate binary latent actions, which a shared predictor maps to alternative future representations. We train the quantum prior through the quality and diversity of these predictions using a sampled energy objective. Our model learns distinct continuations on constructed multimodal tasks and captures latent-action correlations that support coordinated multi-agent futures. On D3IL, a benchmark of diverse human demonstrations, our trained models generate multiple obstacle-crossing routes from a common starting point without observed motion. On the controlled tasks, our classical and quantum prior implementations improve prediction validity and distributional fidelity over the evaluated variational baselines. Our quantum priors combine competitive predictive quality with a parameter-efficient sampling structure: they avoid an exponentially sized categorical output layer while supporting correlated latent actions. We further validate finite-shot parameter-shift training, including training with readout noise. Unlike most prior work, which focuses on simulation, we also verify the feasibility of inference with trained priors on a real QPU. These results establish a trainable quantum component for JEPA future prediction and a basis for exploring quantum-enhanced world models at larger scales.

摘要（中文）：单一观测可能对应多种合理的未来，使得不确定性成为世界建模的核心要素。然而，量子生成模型在这一任务中的潜力尚未得到充分探索。我们提出了Quantum-JEPA，一种潜在动作JEPA框架，利用条件量子玻恩先验学习未来表征的分布。电路测量生成二值潜在动作，共享预测器将这些动作映射为多种可能的未来表征。我们通过采样能量目标，基于预测的质量与多样性对量子先验进行训练。该模型在构造的多模态任务上学习到不同的延续路径，并捕捉到支持多智能体协同未来的潜在动作相关性。在包含多样化人类示范的基准数据集D3IL上，训练得到的模型能够从同一起始点生成多种越障路径，而无需观测运动数据。在受控任务中，我们实现的经典与量子先验在预测有效性和分布保真度上均优于所评估的变分基线。我们的量子先验将具有竞争力的预测质量与参数高效的采样结构相结合：避免了指数规模的类别输出层，同时支持相关的潜在动作。我们进一步验证了有限次采样的参数平移训练方法，包括在含读出噪声条件下的训练。与多数仅关注模拟的既有工作不同，我们还在真实量子处理单元（QPU）上验证了使用训练后先验进行推理的可行性。上述结果表明，我们为JEPA未来预测建立了可训练的量子组件，并为在更大规模上探索量子增强世界模型奠定了基础。

Authors: Zhiyuan Liu, Sicheng Liu, Haiyu Wu

World2HOSI: A Multi-Expert Harness for Long-Horizon Human-Object-Scene Interaction Generation Other

long-horizon HOSI multi-expert orchestration 3D Gaussian Splatting physics simulation data generation

简要说明：World2HOSI 提出了一种多专家编排框架，通过协调现有的 HOI 和 HSI 模型，从 3D 高斯泼溅场景和自然语言指令中生成长期人-物-场景交互数据，并结合物理优化确保动作合理性。

TLDR: World2HOSI introduces a multi-expert orchestration harness that generates long-horizon human-object-scene interaction data from 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes and natural language instructions by coordinating existing HOI and HSI models, with physics-based refinement for physical plausibility.

Abstract: Long-horizon human-object-scene interaction (HOSI) is central to embodied AI, animation, and game development. Existing human-object interaction (HOI) and human-scene interaction (HSI) models excel in their respective domains, but none alone covers tasks requiring multiple interaction skills. Training unified HOSI models is hindered by scarce and costly data. We introduce World2HOSI, a multi-expert orchestration harness that generates continuous HOSI data from 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scenes and natural language instructions. Our key insight is that long-horizon HOSI hinges not on a stronger single model but on orchestration. Given a shared, structured scene state and an orchestration harness grounded in it, existing experts can jointly accomplish tasks beyond the reach of any of them alone. World2HOSI realizes this insight as a closed loop around a persistent scene state built from decoupled background and object assets. A harness plans action stages over this state, invokes experts via their native conditioning interfaces, and writes each action's effects back, so that every invocation is grounded in the evolving world. To reduce physical artifacts, bounded residual optimization and contact-driven physics simulation further ensure the physical plausibility of human motion and object manipulation, respectively, while preserving interaction intent. Experiments and a perceptual user study show that World2HOSI achieves the best task completion and interaction quality on the evaluated HOSI tasks, while generating more diverse data.

摘要（中文）：长时程人-物-场景交互（HOSI）是具身智能、动画和游戏开发的核心问题。现有的人-物交互（HOI）和人-场景交互（HSI）模型在其各自领域表现优异，但没有任何单一模型能够覆盖需要多种交互技能的任务。训练统一HOSI模型受限于稀缺且昂贵的数据。我们提出World2HOSI——一种多专家协同编排框架，能够从3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）场景和自然语言指令中生成连续的HOSI数据。我们的核心洞见在于，长时程HOSI的关键并非更强的单一模型，而是协同编排。给定共享的结构化场景状态以及基于该状态构建的编排框架，现有专家模型可以协同完成超出任何一个单独模型能力范围的任务。World2HOSI将这一洞见实现为围绕持久化场景状态的闭环系统，该场景状态由解耦的背景和物体资产构建。编排框架在该状态上规划动作阶段，通过专家模型的原生条件接口调用它们，并将每个动作的效果写回状态，从而使每次调用都基于不断演化的世界进行。为减少物理伪影，有界残差优化和接触驱动的物理仿真分别进一步确保人体运动和物体操作的物理合理性，同时保持交互意图。实验和感知用户研究表明，World2HOSI在评估的HOSI任务上实现了最佳任务完成度和交互质量，同时生成了更多样化的数据。

Authors: Jiushu Li, Haoran Wang, Yumeng Liu, Zhiyang Dou, Yuan Liu, Yuexin Ma, Cheng Lin

VPFlow: Value-Predictive Planning with Imperfect World Models for Offline Goal Reaching WorldModel

value-predictive planning offline goal-conditioned RL latent world models flow policy evolutionary search

简要说明：本文提出VPFlow，一种价值预测规划器，利用蒙特卡洛回报训练世界模型以实现离线目标达成，证明价值预测而非精确状态预测足以进行有效规划，并在OGBench上超越现有方法。

TLDR: This paper introduces VPFlow, a value-predictive planner that uses Monte Carlo returns to train world models for offline goal-reaching, demonstrating that value prediction, rather than accurate state prediction, is sufficient for effective planning and outperforming existing methods on OGBench.

Abstract: Offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning enables skill acquisition by reaching any goal from any state without dense rewards. Model-based methods allow for planning by scaling test-time compute to solve complex tasks. Combining both holds appealing promise for pre-training on suboptimal demonstrations and zero-shot adaptation via goal specification and planning. Yet existing methods assume effective planning requires accurate next-state prediction in pixel or latent space. In this work, we show that value prediction is more useful for planning, whereas accurate state prediction is often unnecessary. Our key insight is that offline goal reaching naturally admits a closed-form Monte Carlo return, enabling value regression to replace temporal-difference bootstrapping. We use this return as the sole supervision for latent world models: imagined latents are trained to predict goal-reaching value rather than match future states, implicitly preventing representation collapse. These planning-oriented representations let imperfect world models imagine on the level sets of value field beyond dataset transitions. We then present VPFlow, a value-predictive planner that pairs the world models with a one-step flow policy and plans in its noise space via evolutionary search. It enables policy improvement with imagined generalized advantage and reduces out-of-distribution queries common in action-space planning. On 30 state and pixel OGBench datasets, VPFlow surpasses model-free baselines by at least 30.3 and 10.1 percentage points in success rate, respectively, and outperforms latent planners LeWorldModel, PLDM, and TD-MPC2. It achieves this despite a latent prediction error orders of magnitude larger than with state prediction, while minimizing this error lowers success rate. This demonstrates that value-predictive representations, not exact state prediction, are what offline planning requires.

摘要（中文）：离线目标条件强化学习使得智能体能够在无需密集奖励的情况下，从任意状态到达任意目标，从而实现技能获取。基于模型的方法通过扩展测试时计算量来进行规划，以解决复杂任务。将两者结合，为在次优演示数据上进行预训练，并通过目标指定与规划实现零样本适应提供了极具吸引力的前景。然而，现有方法假设有效的规划需要精确的像素或潜在空间中的下一状态预测。在本研究中，我们表明价值预测对规划更为有用，而精确的状态预测往往并非必要。我们的关键洞见在于，离线目标到达问题天然具有闭式蒙特卡洛回报，从而使价值回归能够替代时序差分自举。我们将该回报作为潜在世界模型的唯一监督信号：训练想象出的潜在变量以预测目标到达价值，而非匹配未来状态，从而隐式地防止表示坍缩。这种面向规划的表示使得不完美的世界模型能够在价值场的水平集上进行想象，从而超越数据集中的状态转移。随后，我们提出了VPFlow，一种价值预测规划器，它将世界模型与单步流策略相结合，并通过进化搜索在其噪声空间中进行规划。该方法通过想象出的广义优势估计实现策略改进，并减少了动作空间规划中常见的分布外查询问题。在30个状态和像素级OGBench数据集上，VPFlow的成功率分别比无模型基线高出至少30.3和10.1个百分点，并且优于潜在规划器LeWorldModel、PLDM和TD-MPC2。值得注意的是，尽管其潜在预测误差比状态预测高出数个数量级，VPFlow仍取得了上述性能；而最小化该误差反而会降低成功率。这表明，离线规划所需的正是价值预测性表示，而非精确的状态预测。

Authors: Yunzhe Hu, Dong Xu

AEON: Unifying Video and 3D World Models WorldModel

4D Gaussian Splatting video latent space world simulation 4D reconstruction domain adapter

简要说明：AEON通过统一视频和3D世界模型，在视频潜在空间内生成4D高斯溅射原语，实现了既逼真又几何一致的世界模拟。

TLDR: AEON unifies video-based and 3D-based world models by generating 4D Gaussian Splatting primitives within a video latent space, enabling both photorealistic and geometrically consistent world simulation.

Abstract: Current world models for explicit world simulation typically follow two distinct pathways: (1) video generative models (e.g., Sora), which simulate realistic appearances but fail to preserve 3D consistency; and (2) 3D generative models (e.g., Marble), which generate geometrically consistent scenes but often yield static, less realistic observations. We present AEON, a unified framework that bridges video-based and 3D-based world models and combines the benefits of both. The key insight of AEON lies in a generative model that operates within the text- or image-conditioned video latent space while producing renderable 4D graphics primitives---specifically, 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS)---as the explicit world representation. We train a 4D reconstruction model to predict both 4DGS and camera poses from monocular videos, serving as our initialized 4D decoder. Furthermore, we design a domain adapter that translates generative video latents into reconstructive 4D latents through a distillation process on the video VAE. AEON naturally supports video-based world modeling by rendering 4DGS at predicted camera trajectories, and constructs a persistent 4D environment with scene dynamics for realistic world simulation. Consequently, AEON empowers a diverse range of world modeling applications and achieves state-of-the-art performance on standard benchmarks. Project Page: https://weiqi-zhang.github.io/AEON

摘要（中文）：当前用于显式世界模拟的世界模型通常遵循两条截然不同的路径：（1）视频生成模型（如Sora），能够模拟逼真的外观，但无法保持3D一致性；（2）3D生成模型（如Marble），能够生成几何一致的场景，但往往产生静态且不够真实的观测结果。我们提出了AEON，一个统一框架，弥合了基于视频和基于3D的世界模型之间的鸿沟，并融合了两者的优势。AEON的关键洞察在于，其生成模型在文本或图像条件下的视频潜在空间中运行，同时生成可渲染的4D图形基元——具体而言，即4D高斯泼溅（4DGS）——作为显式世界表示。我们训练了一个4D重建模型，从单目视频中预测4DGS和相机位姿，作为我们初始化的4D解码器。此外，我们设计了一个领域适配器，通过在视频VAE上进行蒸馏过程，将生成式视频潜在变量转换为重建式4D潜在变量。AEON通过沿预测的相机轨迹渲染4DGS，自然支持基于视频的世界建模，并构建具有场景动态的持久4D环境，以实现逼真的世界模拟。因此，AEON赋能了多种多样的世界建模应用，并在标准基准上达到了最先进的性能。项目页面：https://weiqi-zhang.github.io/AEON

Authors: Weiqi Zhang, Wenyuan Zhang, Yu-Shen Liu, Junsheng Zhou

World Models with Configurable Perception WorldModel

world models configurable perception task-conditioned state extraction planning distractor robustness

简要说明：本文提出了ConfigWM，一种通过任务语言描述配置感知的世界模型，选择性地提取任务相关状态表示，在嘈杂环境中实现稳健规划，优于现有方法。

TLDR: This paper introduces ConfigWM, a world model that uses task language descriptions to configure perception, selectively extracting task-relevant state representations for robust planning in noisy environments, outperforming existing methods.

Abstract: Real-world observations are noisy and often contain excessive task-irrelevant information. Effective world modeling and planning need to abstract observations into world state representations while filtering out irrelevant information. However, encoders in existing world models are typically non-adaptive, leading to state representations that are easily distracted by task-irrelevant information. As a result, the model may not selectively filter observations to cater to different task demands. To address this problem, we introduce ConfigWM, which realizes configurable perception through task-conditioned state extraction. Given a language description of the task at hand, ConfigWM uses it as a configuration signal to steer how visual embeddings are mapped into a task-specific state space, selectively preserving information relevant to the current task while suppressing task-irrelevant variations. Action-conditioned dynamics are then learned in this task-specific state space for planning. We evaluate ConfigWM in environments with increasing levels of distraction. While existing methods exhibit substantial declines in planning success rate as the environments become increasingly noisy, ConfigWM remains comparatively stable and outperforms the strongest competing method by 22.3% on average across diverse environments. Consistent gains in physical-quantity probing (+0.365 Pearson r) and distracted-to-clean retrieval (+75.5%) further indicate that ConfigWM learns states that preserve task-relevant information while remaining robust to distractors, supporting reliable world modeling and planning in noisy worlds. Project Page: https://configwm.github.io

摘要（中文）：现实世界的观测往往包含噪声，并常含有大量与任务无关的冗余信息。有效的世界建模与规划需要将观测抽象为世界状态表示，同时过滤掉无关信息。然而，现有世界模型中的编码器通常是非自适应的，导致状态表示易受任务无关信息干扰。因此，模型可能无法有选择性地过滤观测以适配不同的任务需求。为解决这一问题，我们提出了ConfigWM，通过任务条件化的状态提取实现可配置感知。给定当前任务的语言描述，ConfigWM将其作为配置信号，引导视觉嵌入映射到特定任务的状态空间，有选择地保留与当前任务相关的信息，同时抑制与任务无关的变化。随后，在该任务特定状态空间中学习基于动作的条件动力学以进行规划。我们在干扰程度递增的环境中对ConfigWM进行了评估。随着环境噪声逐渐增强，现有方法的规划成功率显著下降，而ConfigWM保持相对稳定，并在多种环境中平均超越最强基线方法22.3%。在物理量探测（+0.365皮尔逊相关系数）及干扰到干净环境检索（+75.5%）方面的一致提升进一步表明，ConfigWM学习到的状态能够保留任务相关信息，同时对干扰因素保持鲁棒性，从而支持在噪声世界中进行可靠的世界建模与规划。项目页面：https://configwm.github.io

Authors: Yijun Shen, Delong Chen, Xianming Hu, Kai Zhang, Pascale Fung

Provisioning Robust and Efficient LiDAR Perception for Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

LiDAR perception 3D object detection robustness efficiency autonomous driving

简要说明：本文提出一种为自动驾驶配置LiDAR三维目标检测的方法，在提高对点云损坏鲁棒性的同时降低推理延迟和GPU内存占用，在KITTI等数据集上取得显著提升。

TLDR: This paper proposes a method to provision LiDAR-based 3D object detection for autonomous driving, improving robustness to point-cloud corruptions while simultaneously reducing inference latency and GPU memory usage, achieving significant gains on KITTI and other datasets.

Abstract: LiDAR-based 3D object detection is a core perception service for autonomous driving, but deployment requires robustness to point-cloud corruption while meeting latency and memory requirements. Existing approaches address robustness and resource efficiency separately, resulting in compact detectors that are fragile under corruption or robust detectors that remain costly to deploy. We therefore formulate LiDAR perception provisioning as constructing a detector that remains accurate under point-cloud corruptions while meeting constraints on inference latency and peak GPU memory. To achieve robustness, we first craft corrupted samples that mimic extreme weather conditions. Then we train candidate detectors offline by ordering clean and corrupted samples by perturbation sensitivity, through which detectors learn more from hard corrupted samples. We estimate perturbation sensitivity using an ensemble of seven heterogeneous 3D detectors by tracking changes in confidence, BEV overlap, and unmatched detections. To improve efficiency, we narrow the network and use offline neighborhood-density measurements to determine how many points and neighbors each sampling stage processes. We evaluate our method using AP (Average Precision) under clean and corrupted conditions, inference latency, and peak allocated GPU memory. On KITTI for Car detection with PointRCNN, our method improves Moderate AP under corruption by 3.32 points over the original detector while reducing mean latency by 19.8% and peak allocated GPU memory by 53.9%. Across two datasets, two detector architectures, and three object classes, our method improves AP under corruption by 4.03 points on average over the corresponding original detectors, while reducing mean inference latency and peak allocated GPU memory by 14.4% and 38.0%, respectively. Our code is available at https://github.com/drunklibai/robust-efficient-lidar-perception.

摘要（中文）：基于LiDAR的三维物体检测是自动驾驶中的一项核心感知服务，但其部署要求在应对点云损坏的同时满足延迟和内存限制。现有方法分别处理鲁棒性和资源效率问题，导致要么生成的紧凑检测器在损坏条件下表现脆弱，要么鲁棒检测器部署成本仍然较高。因此，我们将LiDAR感知供给问题建模为构建一个在点云损坏条件下仍能保持准确性，同时满足推理延迟和峰值GPU内存约束的检测器。为实现鲁棒性，我们首先构造模拟极端天气条件的损坏样本。随后，通过按扰动敏感性对干净样本和损坏样本进行排序，离线训练候选检测器，从而使检测器从困难的损坏样本中学习更多信息。我们利用七个异构三维检测器组成的集成模型，通过跟踪置信度变化、鸟瞰图重叠度和未匹配检测数来估计扰动敏感性。为提高效率，我们收窄网络结构，并利用离线的邻域密度测量结果确定每个采样阶段处理的点数和邻居数。我们使用干净及损坏条件下的平均精度（AP）、推理延迟和峰值分配GPU内存来评估我们的方法。在KITTI数据集上使用PointRCNN进行车辆检测时，我们的方法在损坏条件下将中等难度AP提升了3.32个百分点，同时将平均延迟降低了19.8%，峰值分配GPU内存降低了53.9%。在两个数据集、两种检测器架构和三个物体类别上，相较于对应的原始检测器，我们的方法在损坏条件下平均将AP提升了4.03个百分点，同时将平均推理延迟和峰值分配GPU内存分别降低了14.4%和38.0%。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/drunklibai/robust-efficient-lidar-perception 获取。

Authors: Tingxu Han, Zijie Shen, An Guo, Lyuke Wang, Chunrong Fang, Zhenyu Chen, Wei Song

LVMem: Image-Augmented Memory for Long-Horizon Question Answering Other

view-based memory long-horizon QA VLM agent optical-flow frame selection object-centric scene representation

简要说明：本文提出了LVMem，一种用于具身代理长时程时空问答的基于视图的记忆框架，通过将描述与原始图像关联、基于光流的帧选择和以物体为中心的描述，以及自适应检索机制，在OC-NaVQA基准上提升了性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces LVMem, a view-based memory framework for long-horizon spatio-temporal question answering in embodied agents, augmenting captions with linked image paths, optical-flow-based frame selection, object-centric descriptions, and adaptive VLM-based retrieval to improve performance on the OC-NaVQA benchmark.

Abstract: Reliable language-guided perception is essential for embodied agents, where questions about objects, events, and their locations must be answered from long observation histories. Unlike conventional visual question answering, realistic robotic settings require reasoning over extended temporal horizons and persistent scene memory. We build upon the view-based memory paradigm and propose an efficient framework for long-horizon spatio-temporal question answering. While existing view-based systems typically store either text captions or visual embeddings, we extend the ReMEmbR-style memory with image paths that link each stored description to its original visual content. To make the stored annotations more informative, we replace uniform sampling during memory construction with an optical-flow-based frame selection strategy (PSFR) and store an object-centric descriptive scene representation instead of plain captions. We further equip a VLM-based agent with an adaptive retrieval tool that returns the image associated with the most relevant caption, allowing the agent to decide when visual inspection is needed. On the OC-NaVQA benchmark, LVMem outperforms ReMEmbR on binary and positional metrics with both backbones and matches or exceeds a 4D scene graph DAAAM baseline on binary accuracy, while operating on a lightweight view-based memory that requires no explicit graph construction.

摘要（中文）：可靠的语言引导感知对于具身智能体至关重要，它需要从长时间观测历史中回答关于物体、事件及其位置的问题。与传统视觉问答不同，真实机器人场景要求跨越长时间范围进行推理，并具备持久的场景记忆。我们基于视图记忆范式，提出了一种面向长时程时空问答的高效框架。现有基于视图的系统通常仅存储文本描述或视觉嵌入，而我们扩展了ReMEmbR风格的记忆，增加了图像路径，将每条存储的描述链接回其原始视觉内容。为使存储的标注更具信息量，我们在记忆构建阶段用基于光流的帧选择策略（PSFR）替代均匀采样，并存储以物体为中心的描述性场景表示，而非简单标题。我们进一步为基于VLM的智能体配备了自适应检索工具，该工具返回与最相关描述对应的图像，使智能体能够自主决定何时需要视觉检查。在OC-NaVQA基准上，LVMem在二进制和位置指标上均优于ReMEmbR（两种骨干网络均如此），在二进制准确率上达到或超过4D场景图DAAAM基线，同时运行在轻量级视图记忆之上，无需显式构建图结构。

Authors: Victoria Khoruzhaya, Maksim Kalmykov, Tuong Do Minh, Tatiana Zemskova, Yixin Zhu, Dmitry Yudin

MAPLE: Mondrian-Anchored Prior for Learning-free Indoor Exploration Other

Mondrian process exploration occupancy prediction frontier gain learning-free

简要说明：本文提出MAPLE，一种基于蒙德里安过程的免训练预测方法，用于室内探索，通过生成地图假设并评估前沿增益来提高探索效率，无需学习模型。

TLDR: This paper presents MAPLE, a training-free predictive approach for indoor exploration that uses a Mondrian process as a generative prior conditioned on observed geometric cues to generate map hypotheses and estimate frontier gain, improving exploration efficiency without learned models.

Abstract: Robots exploring unknown indoor environments must decide where to move while much of the environment remains unseen. Predicting the occupancy of unseen space beyond the current sensor range can improve these decisions, but recent approaches commonly rely on learned models that require offline training and repeated inference during exploration. We introduce the Mondrian-Anchored Prior for Learning-free Indoor Exploration (MAPLE), a training-free predictive approach that adapts the Mondrian process into an online generative prior conditioned on observed geometric cues in the current partial map. MAPLE generates multiple plausible map hypotheses and evaluates visibility separately within each to estimate frontier gain, preserving differences in predicted visibility across hypotheses. Across KTH floor-plans and real-SLAM environments at multiple sensor ranges, MAPLE consistently improves over non-predictive exploration and remains competitive with learned predictive approaches. Its lightweight procedural construction enables predictive exploration with limited computational resources. Experimental results further show that more accurate map prediction does not necessarily produce better exploration, highlighting the importance of how predictions are represented and used in exploration decisions.

摘要（中文）：机器人探索未知室内环境时，必须在大部分环境仍未被观测到的情况下决定移动方向。预测超出当前传感器范围之外未知空间的占用情况，可以改善这些决策，但近年来的方法通常依赖需要离线训练并在探索过程中反复推理的学习模型。我们提出了一种基于蒙德里安装饰先验的无学习室内探索方法（MAPLE），这是一种无需训练的自适应预测方法，将蒙德里安过程调整为在线生成先验，并以当前局部地图中观测到的几何线索为条件。MAPLE生成多个合理的候选地图假设，并在每个假设中分别评估可见性以估计前沿增益，从而保留不同假设间预测可见性的差异。在KTH平面图和多种传感器量程下的真实SLAM环境中，MAPLE始终优于非预测式探索方法，并与学习型预测方法表现相当。其轻量级程序化构造使得在有限计算资源下实现预测式探索成为可能。实验进一步表明，更精确的地图预测并不一定带来更好的探索效果，这凸显了预测结果的表示方式及其在探索决策中的应用方式的重要性。

Authors: Kelvin Aladum, Nisar Ahmed

CAPSafe: A Benchmark for Contextual Action and Plan Safety Reasoning in Embodied Agents Other

safety reasoning embodied agents LLM evaluation long-horizon planning hazard recognition

简要说明：CAPSafe是一个用于评估具身智能体中LLM安全推理的基准测试，分为单动作和长期规划两个层面，揭示了识别不安全动作与生成安全计划之间的显著差距。

TLDR: CAPSafe is a benchmark for evaluating LLM safety reasoning in embodied household agents at both single-action and long-horizon plan levels, revealing a significant gap between recognizing unsafe actions and generating safe plans.

Abstract: Reasoning about safety is essential for embodied agents powered by large language models (LLMs). We introduce the Contextual Action and Plan Safety benchmark (CAPSafe), designed to evaluate safety reasoning at two levels: (1) an action-level dataset that tests whether a single action is safe given its environmental context, and (2) a plan-level dataset that evaluates whether agents can generate safe long-horizon plans for complex hazardous household tasks. CAPSafe models safety conditions where hazards are situational (inferred from object properties), multiple hazards can co-occur within the same environment, and each is annotated with a relative severity level for fine-grained analysis. Evaluating nine closed and open-source LLMs reveals a substantial gap between hazard recognition and safe long-horizon planning. Several models achieve high accuracy in recognizing unsafe actions (exceeding 90% in the best cases), yet safe long-horizon planning remains substantially harder. Gemini-3-pro achieves the highest safe success rate (78.19%), while other models remain below 65%. These results highlight that robust safety reasoning over long action sequences remains an open challenge.

摘要（中文）：推理安全性对于由大型语言模型（LLMs）驱动的具身智能体至关重要。我们引入了情境动作与计划安全基准（CAPSafe），旨在从两个层面评估安全推理能力：（1）动作级数据集，用于测试在给定环境情境下单个动作是否安全；（2）计划级数据集，用于评估智能体能否为复杂的危险家务任务生成安全的长期计划。CAPSafe模型化了多种安全条件，其中危险具有情境性（由物体属性推断而来），多种危险可在同一环境中并发出现，且每种危险均标注有相对严重程度以支持细粒度分析。对九种闭源和开源LLMs的评估揭示出危险识别与安全长期规划之间存在显著差距。若干模型在识别不安全动作方面取得了较高准确率（最佳情况下超过90%），但安全的长期规划仍然困难得多。Gemini-3-pro取得了最高的安全成功率（78.19%），而其他模型均低于65%。这些结果表明，在长动作序列上进行稳健的安全推理仍是一个未解决的开放挑战。

Authors: Youmna Farag, Svetlana Stoyanchev, Simon Keizer, Mohan Li, Rama Doddipatla

Safe Multi-Robot Collaboration With Uniform Exclusion Using Trust Other

multi-robot coordination trust inference safe anytime-valid inference adversarial communication robot swarms

简要说明：本文提出一种多机器人通信包装算法，在可能存在对抗攻击的情况下安全选择可信链路，以高概率保证统一排除受损链路并快速学习合法链路，已在硬件和仿真中验证。

TLDR: This paper presents a wrapper algorithm for multi-robot communication that safely selects trusted links under possible adversarial attacks, guaranteeing uniform exclusion of compromised links with high probability while quickly learning legitimate ones, validated on hardware and in simulation.

Abstract: Robot swarms coordinate through directed, time-varying local communication links, some of which may be compromised to allow the transmission of arbitrary malicious data. We provide an algorithm that acts as a wrapper around robot communication---when a robot seeks to update its state using data from some incoming links, our wrapper provides a subset of trusted links whose data can be safely incorporated. It selects these links by testing a stream of trust values---data collected from an anomaly detector on each robot---using Safe Anytime-Valid Inference. We require only that the detector be better than chance. This wrapper ensures safe and performant autonomy by providing two powerful statistical guarantees: it uniformly excludes all compromised links for all time with high user-chosen probability, but nevertheless quickly learns to trust legitimate links. Both guarantees are vital to secure generic tasks, but no previous work provides them simultaneously without restrictive assumptions on connectivity structure or the number of compromised links that are not guaranteed in practice. We study our Safe Wrapper's performance in hardware for two contrasting tasks---neural implicit mapping and heading consensus---deploying on 3 LoCoBots and 8 GoPiGos, respectively. We provide simulations using trust values sampled from hardware to validate that our approach scales well to swarms of hundreds of robots.

摘要（中文）：机器人群体通过有向、时变的局部通信链路进行协调，其中部分链路可能被攻陷，从而允许传输任意恶意数据。我们提出了一种算法，作为机器人通信的封装层——当机器人试图利用某些传入链路的数据更新自身状态时，该封装层会提供一组可信链路的子集，使来自这些链路的数据能够被安全地整合。它通过使用安全任意时间有效推断（Safe Anytime-Valid Inference）来检验信任值流——即从每个机器人上的异常检测器收集的数据——从而选择这些链路。我们仅要求检测器的性能优于随机猜测。该封装层通过提供两项强有力的统计保证来确保安全且高性能的自主性：它以用户选定的高概率在所有时间内一致地排除所有被攻陷的链路，同时仍能快速学会信任合法链路。这两项保证对于保障通用任务的安全性至关重要，但以往没有任何工作能在不对连通性结构或被攻陷链路数量做出实践中无法保证的限制性假设的前提下，同时提供这两项保证。我们在硬件上针对两个对比性任务——神经隐式映射和航向一致性——评估了所提出的安全封装层的性能，分别部署于3台LoCoBot和8台GoPiGo机器人上。我们还提供了使用从硬件采样的信任值进行仿真的结果，以验证该方法可良好扩展至由数百台机器人组成的群体。

Authors: Thomas Kaminsky, Áron Vékássy, Hammad Izhar, Angelia Nedić, Stephanie Gil

Interruption-Aware Recurrent Reinforcement Learning for UAS Navigation Under Temporary Overrides RLRobot

Reinforcement learning UAS navigation Recurrent policies Temporary overrides Interruption-aware architectures

简要说明：本文提出了针对无人机导航的中断感知循环强化学习架构，解决了安全覆盖导致隐藏状态损坏和碰撞风险增加的问题，将中断后碰撞率降低了74%。

TLDR: This paper introduces interruption-aware recurrent reinforcement learning architectures for UAS navigation, addressing the hidden-state corruption and collision risk that occur when policies are temporarily overridden by safety systems, achieving a 74% reduction in post-interruption collisions.

Abstract: Safe autonomous navigation of UASs requires tactical deconfliction to address conflicts that strategic coordination cannot prevent. This task is challenging under partial observability, when sensor or traffic data are missing, delayed, or degraded. Geometry-based methods can offer separation assurances but face limitations in dense encounters. Recurrent reinforcement learning has therefore been proposed to learn navigation policies that integrate observation-action histories to optimise long-term safety-efficiency trade-offs. However, operational safeguards may require a remote pilot, onboard detect-and-avoid system, or runtime assurance mechanism to temporarily override the learned policy. A research gap remains in understanding how these interruptions affect recurrent policies when the agent regains authority. Benchmark evidence shows that interruptions make task variables less decodable from the recurrent hidden state and increase post-interruption collision risk. The findings suggest that altered recurrent context prolongs post-handback degradation through an action-observation feedback loop, in which changed actions alter the flight path and subsequent recurrent updates. To address this vulnerability, we propose three interruption-aware architectures that condition recurrent processing on interruption context through separate feature streams, dedicated interruption memory, or gated environmental features. Across simulations, all three architectures preserve more decodable task information than a standard recurrent policy. Moreover, the strongest architecture reduces post-interruption collisions by 74% and interruption-induced mission failures by 69% relative to the recurrent baseline, without degrading interruption-free performance. These results show that safe interruption does not guarantee safe handback, and support interruption-aware recurrent design for resilient UAS autonomy.

摘要（中文）：无人航空系统（UAS）的安全自主导航需要战术冲突消解，以应对战略协调无法预防的冲突。在部分可观测条件下，当传感器或交通数据缺失、延迟或降质时，该任务尤为具有挑战性。基于几何的方法能够提供间隔保障，但在密集相遇场景中面临局限。因此，循环强化学习被提出用于学习导航策略，通过整合观测-动作历史来优化长期安全-效率权衡。然而，运行保障机制可能要求远程驾驶员、机载探测与规避系统或运行时保证机制临时覆盖所学策略。当前研究仍存在空白：当智能体重新获得控制权后，这些中断如何影响循环策略尚不明确。基准实验证据表明，中断会使任务变量从循环隐状态中的可解码性降低，并增加中断后的碰撞风险。研究结果表明，改变的循环上下文通过动作-观测反馈回路延长了交还后的性能退化，在该回路中，改变的动作会改变飞行路径及后续的循环更新。为解决这一脆弱性，我们提出了三种中断感知架构，通过独立特征流、专用中断记忆或门控环境特征，将循环处理条件化于中断上下文之上。跨模拟实验表明，三种架构均比标准循环策略保留更多可解码的任务信息。此外，最强架构相较于循环基线将中断后碰撞减少74%，将中断诱发的任务失败减少69%，且不降低无中断时的性能。这些结果表明，安全中断并不保证安全交还，并支持采用中断感知的循环设计以实现具有韧性的UAS自主性。

简要说明：本文提出了用于球形移动测绘系统的基于RANSAC的地面法向量估计方法，比较了单扫描和LiDAR惯性里程计方法，并表明基于LIO的估计可提高位姿估计精度。

TLDR: This paper presents RANSAC-based methods for ground normal estimation in spherical mobile mapping systems, comparing single-scan and LiDAR-inertial odometry approaches, and shows that LIO-based estimation improves pose estimation accuracy.

Abstract: Accurate ground plane normal estimation is essential for odometry in spherical mobile mapping systems (SMMS), which face challenges from rapid rotations and limited ground coverage. We propose two RANSAC-based approaches: single-scan estimation with normal vector scoring and multi-step validation, and LiDAR-inertial odometry (LIO)-based estimation using a global 3D map. Evaluated across diverse real-world datasets against terrestrial laser scanner ground truth, results show that LIO-based estimation significantly outperforms single-scan methods in accuracy and robustness. Integrating ground normal estimates into the motion model improves pose estimation, supporting autonomous navigation in challenging and hazardous environments.

摘要（中文）：地面平面法向量估计的准确性对于球形移动测绘系统（SMMS）中的里程计至关重要，该系统面临快速旋转和地面覆盖范围有限等挑战。我们提出了两种基于RANSAC的方法：采用法向量评分与多步骤验证的单次扫描估计方法，以及利用全局三维地图的基于激光雷达-惯性里程计（LIO）的估计方法。在多种真实世界数据集上，以地面激光扫描仪数据为基准进行评估，结果表明基于LIO的估计方法在精度和鲁棒性上显著优于单次扫描方法。将地面法向量估计集成到运动模型中，能够改善位姿估计，从而支持在复杂和危险环境中的自主导航。

PanoGraphGS: Unifying Panoptic Segmentation and Hierarchical 3D Scene Graphs with Gaussian Splatting Other

3D scene graphs panoptic segmentation Gaussian Splatting navigation scene understanding

简要说明：PanoGraphGS 将全景3D高斯表示学习与层次化3D场景图构建统一，用于语言引导导航，在场景图识别和2D全景分割中达到目前最优性能，并发布了新真实数据集NaviGS。

TLDR: PanoGraphGS unifies panoptic 3D Gaussian representation learning with hierarchical 3D scene graph construction for language-guided navigation, achieving state-of-the-art performance in scene graph identification and 2D panoptic segmentation, and releasing a new real-world dataset NaviGS.

Abstract: 3D scene graphs support language-guided navigation by organizing physical entities and their containment and spatial relations into hierarchical maps. Building such structured maps requires a scene representation that consistently distinguishes semantic regions and object instances across viewpoints. To this end, we present PanoGraphGS, a unified framework that integrates panoptic 3D Gaussian representation learning with hierarchical 3D scene graph construction. The framework learns semantic and instance features on shared Gaussian geometry. Prototype-based semantic learning and association-based instance learning produce consistent panoptic predictions across viewpoints. The learned representation supports novel-view panoptic segmentation and direct Gaussian-level panoptic decoding. A semantic-aware scene graph module further recovers a floor-room-stuff-object hierarchy with containment and spatial relations. We further release NaviGS, a real-world dataset for panoramic scene understanding. The dataset provides 3DGS, mesh, RGB, semantic, and depth data. For 3D scene graph identification, PanoGraphGS outperforms the strongest evaluated baseline in object-node accuracy by more than 50\% points on average across Replica and NaviGS. PanoGraphGS also achieves state-of-the-art performance among the evaluated methods in 2D panoptic segmentation. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of PanoGraphGS in both hierarchical 3D scene understanding and 2D panoptic segmentation. The project website is available at: https://github.com/gaojh0333/PanoGraphGS.

摘要（中文）：3D场景图通过将物理实体及其包含关系和空间关系组织为层次化地图，为语言引导的导航提供支持。构建此类结构化地图需要一种场景表示，能够在不同视角下一致地区分语义区域和对象实例。为此，我们提出了PanoGraphGS，一个统一框架，将全景3D高斯表示学习与层次化3D场景图构建相结合。该框架在共享的高斯几何上学习语义特征和实例特征。基于原型的语义学习和基于关联的实例学习可在不同视角下产生一致的全景预测。所学表示支持新视角全景分割以及直接的高斯级全景解码。一个语义感知的场景图模块进一步恢复出包含“楼层-房间-物体-杂物”层次结构及其包含关系和空间关系的层级关系。我们还发布了NaviGS，一个用于全景场景理解的真实世界数据集。该数据集提供3DGS、网格、RGB、语义和深度数据。在3D场景图识别方面，PanoGraphGS在Replica和NaviGS上的对象节点准确率平均比最强评估基线高出超过50个百分点。在评估方法中，PanoGraphGS在2D全景分割方面也达到了最先进的性能。这些结果证明了PanoGraphGS在层次化3D场景理解和2D全景分割方面的有效性。项目网站：https://github.com/gaojh0333/PanoGraphGS。

Authors: Jinghan Gao, Siyu Wang, Dongyu Feng, Yiyuan Pan, Rong Xiong

thermal imaging autonomous electrosurgery closed-loop control velocity optimization robotic surgery

简要说明：THERMO 是一种利用热成像优化自主电外科手术机器人速度的闭环算法，在离体猪组织中减少热损伤并提高切缘准确性。

TLDR: THERMO is a closed-loop algorithm that uses thermal imaging to optimize the velocity of an autonomous electrosurgery robot, reducing thermal injury and improving margin accuracy in ex vivo porcine tissue.

Abstract: Objective: To demonstrate and evaluate THERMO, a thermal-velocity optimization algorithm for autonomous electrosurgery, in ex vivo porcine tissue using the UR10e-based ASTR system. Methods: Thermography for Electrosurgical Rate Modulation via Optimization (ThERMO), a closed-loop algorithm that uses real-time thermal imaging data to minimize thermal injury while ensuring accurate cut margins, was tested on ex vivo porcine tissue. Histological analysis was performed to detect thermal injury extent at a cellular level, and 3D photogrammetric measurement was used to verify margin accuracy. ThERMO's performance was compared against two previously used fixed velocity methods. Results: ThERMO outperformed both fixed velocity comparison methods without requiring data-driven training or iterative tuning, reducing thermal injury by up to 52%, improving cut accuracy by up to 59%, and maintaining task completion speed. Conclusions: Closed-loop thermal feedback via ThERMO improves autonomous robotic electrosurgery by simultaneously reducing thermal injury and improving margin accuracy, reinforcing its value over fixed velocity approaches for tumor resection applications. Significance: This work advances autonomous robotic tumor resection by demonstrating that real-time closed-loop thermal feedback control can substantially reduce collateral tissue damage and improve surgical margin accuracy.

摘要（中文）：目的：在离体猪组织上，利用基于UR10e的ASTR系统，展示并评估用于自主电外科手术的热速度优化算法THERMO。方法：通过优化实现电外科热速率调节的热成像技术（ThERMO），一种利用实时热成像数据来最小化热损伤同时确保切割边缘精确性的闭环算法，在离体猪组织上进行了测试。进行了组织学分析以在细胞水平检测热损伤程度，并使用3D摄影测量技术验证边缘准确性。将ThERMO的性能与先前使用的两种固定速度方法进行了比较。结果：ThERMO在无需数据驱动训练或迭代调优的情况下，优于两种固定速度比较方法，热损伤减少了高达52%，切割准确性提高了高达59%，同时保持了任务完成速度。结论：通过ThERMO实现的闭环热反馈，通过同时减少热损伤和提高边缘准确性，改善了自主机器人电外科手术，强化了其在肿瘤切除应用中相较于固定速度方法的优势。意义：本研究通过证明实时闭环热反馈控制能够显著减少附带组织损伤并改善手术边缘准确性，推进了自主机器人肿瘤切除技术的发展。

Authors: Naveed D. Riaziat, Jiawei Ge, Ethan Kilmer, Michael W. Mikula, Paul Maria Scheikl, Michael Kam, Leila J. Mady, Axel Krieger, Jeremy D. Brown

OmniVLoc: Topo-metric Visual Localization for Omnidirectional Cameras Perception3D

omnidirectional visual localization topo-metric framework global place recognition monocular depth estimation spherical bundle adjustment

简要说明：OmniVLoc 提出了一种用于全景相机的拓扑-度量视觉定位系统，结合全局地点识别和单目深度估计，通过尺度感知位姿图和球面光束平差，实现精确且鲁棒的度量级位姿估计。

TLDR: OmniVLoc proposes a topo-metric visual localization system for omnidirectional cameras, integrating global place recognition and monocular depth estimation with spherical bundle adjustment and a hierarchical verification mechanism to achieve accurate and robust metric-level pose estimation.

Abstract: Omnidirectional cameras provide surround-view information, significantly overcoming the field-of-view constraints for traditional visual localization systems. However, existing localization systems fail to fully exploit the characteristics of omnidirectional cameras, struggling to deliver accurate and robust localization performance amidst scene content variations and illumination-induced appearance changes. In this work, we propose OmniVLoc, a surround-view localization system based on a topo-metric framework. By integrating state-of-the-art global place recognition and monocular depth estimation methods, we introduce a multi-constrained visual localization paradigm. By solving a scale-aware pose graph and performing precise spherical bundle adjustment, we accurately recover the metric-level pose for each query frame.Furthermore, a hierarchical verification mechanism is designed to filter out erroneous outputs across different stages, effectively bolstering the overall system robustness. Extensive experiments on both public and our custom datasets validate the superior accuracy and reliability of OmniVLoc. To benefit the community, our source code and dataset will be made publicly available upon publication.

摘要（中文）：全方位相机提供全景信息，显著克服了传统视觉定位系统在视场角上的局限性。然而，现有定位系统未能充分利用全方位相机的特性，在场景内容变化和光照引起的外观变化中，难以实现精确且鲁棒的定位性能。在本研究中，我们提出了OmniVLoc——一种基于拓扑-度量框架的全景定位系统。通过整合最先进的全局地点识别和单目深度估计方法，我们引入了一种多约束视觉定位范式。通过求解尺度感知的位姿图并执行精确的球面光束法平差，我们准确恢复每帧查询图像的度量级位姿。此外，设计了一种分层验证机制，用于在不同阶段过滤错误输出，有效增强系统整体鲁棒性。在公开数据集及自建数据集上的大量实验验证了OmniVLoc在精度和可靠性方面的优越性。为回馈社区，我们的源代码和数据集将在论文发表后公开提供。

Authors: Zhuo Yu, Shuyang Zhang, Huihua Zhu, Wenjia Ouyang, Zuo Zuo, Jianhao Jiao, Yilong Zhu, Xiaopin Zhong, Zongze Wu

Robot-Task Suitability in Heterogeneous Multi-Robot Task Allocation Other

multi-robot task allocation robot-task suitability LLM-based scoring heterogeneous robots feasibility

简要说明：本文比较了异构多机器人任务分配中评估机器人-任务适合性的十种确定性方法和两种基于LLM的方法，发现它们经常产生分歧，强调了显式建模选择的重要性。

TLDR: This paper compares ten deterministic and two LLM-based methods for estimating robot-task suitability in heterogeneous multi-robot task allocation, finding frequent disagreements and highlighting the need for explicit modeling choices.

Abstract: Heterogeneous multi-robot task allocation depends on estimates of how suitable individual robots are for candidate tasks, yet suitability can be defined in substantially different ways. We compare ten deterministic methods and two LLM-based variants spanning rule-based, similarity-based, requirement-oriented, fuzzy, and semantic approaches. Using common robot and task profiles, we compare how the methods score and rank candidate robots, identify feasibility, and select a top robot, while examining how these outcomes change with team composition, scale, spatial context, capability uncertainty, and task representation. The methods frequently disagree despite operating on identical scenarios. Generic similarity measures can violate properties expected under a one-sided requirement-satisfaction interpretation of suitability, while LLM-based scoring introduces additional stochastic and linguistic sensitivity. These results show that robot--task suitability should be treated as an explicit modeling choice whose assumptions, robustness, and decision-level consequences should be considered before allocation.

摘要（中文）：异构多机器人任务分配依赖于对单个机器人适合候选任务程度的估计，然而适合性的定义方式可能存在显著差异。我们比较了十种确定性方法和两种基于大语言模型的变体，涵盖基于规则、基于相似性、面向需求、模糊和语义等方法。利用通用的机器人和任务档案，我们比较了这些方法如何对候选机器人进行评分和排序、识别可行性并选择最优机器人，同时考察了这些结果如何随团队组成、规模、空间情境、能力不确定性及任务表示的变化而改变。尽管在相同场景下运行，这些方法常常得出相互不一致的结果。通用相似性度量可能违反在适合性的一种单边需求满足解释下所预期的属性，而基于大语言模型的评分则引入了额外的随机性和语言敏感性。这些结果表明，机器人-任务适合性应被视为一种明确的建模选择，在分配之前应考虑其假设、稳健性及决策层面的后果。

Authors: Daniel Weiner, Raj Korpan

Real-Time Disturbance-Aware Koopman Model Predictive Control for Quadrotors in Spatially Varying Winds Other

disturbance-aware Koopman Control Family Model Predictive Control quadrotor online adaptation

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于四旋翼飞行器的扰动感知Koopman控制族（DA-KCF）框架，结合固定的离线标称模型与在线学习的残差修正，并在MPC控制器中应用。在均匀风和非均匀尾流中的硬件实验表明，该方法提高了轨迹跟踪精度并满足实时控制要求。

TLDR: This paper introduces a disturbance-aware Koopman Control Family (DA-KCF) framework for quadrotors, combining a fixed offline nominal model with online-learned residual corrections in an MPC controller. Hardware experiments on a nano-quadrotor in uniform and spatially varying winds demonstrate improved trajectory tracking and real-time performance.

Abstract: Reliable quadrotor flight in disturbed environments requires predictive models that remain accurate as unmodeled aerodynamic effects change during deployment. We introduce a disturbance-aware Koopman Control Family (DA-KCF) framework that preserves an offline-identified nominal model while learning only a disturbance-induced correction online. A reference-dependent KCF is first learned from simulation data and calibrated using limited hardware data. During deployment, the nominal KCF remains fixed while a lightweight residual ensemble learns a low-dimensional disturbance correction from causal state-command-state transitions. The Adaptive DA-KCF model is incorporated into MPC, where disturbance corrections are evaluated along the prediction horizon to optimize position and yaw references sent to the onboard stabilizing controller. Hardware experiments on a nano-quadrotor under uniform wind and a spatially varying wake demonstrate that online adaptation improves multi-step prediction and trajectory tracking as disturbance-induced model mismatch increases, while satisfying real-time control requirements.

摘要（中文）：在受扰环境中实现可靠的四旋翼飞行，需要预测模型在部署期间随着未建模气动效应的变化保持准确。我们提出了一种扰动感知的Koopman控制族（DA-KCF）框架，该框架在保留离线辨识的名义模型的同时，仅在线学习扰动引起的修正项。首先，从仿真数据中学习一个参考相关的KCF，并使用少量硬件数据进行校准。在部署过程中，名义KCF保持固定，而轻量级残差集成从因果状态-指令-状态转换中学习低维扰动修正。自适应DA-KCF模型被集成到模型预测控制（MPC）中，沿预测时域评估扰动修正，以优化发送给机载稳定控制器的位置和偏航参考。在均匀风和空间变化尾流条件下的纳米四旋翼硬件实验表明，随着扰动引起的模型失配增加，在线自适应能够改善多步预测和轨迹跟踪性能，同时满足实时控制要求。

Authors: Stella Kombo, Masih Haseli, Alejandro A. Stefan-Zavala, Peter I. Renn, Morteza Gharib, Joel W. Burdick

RadGeoLoc: Radar Geolocalization via Particle Filtering Perception3D

radar geolocalization particle filter masked reconstruction satellite image alignment autonomous field robots

简要说明：RadGeoLoc 使用学习观测模型和粒子滤波，将地面雷达与卫星图像进行定位，在城区/越野和长期天气变化下表现出鲁棒性。

TLDR: RadGeoLoc localizes a ground radar against overhead satellite imagery using a learned observation model and particle filter, demonstrating robustness across urban/offroad and long-term weather changes.

Abstract: In real-time autonomous field applications, GNSS is often unreliable and inaccurate. A possible solution is localizing against a prebuilt map like a satellite image, as it is georeferenced and already surveyed. In this work, we localize a spinning radar measurement against overhead RGB imagery with a learned observation model. We use a radar representation pretrained by masked reconstruction and align it to features from a satellite image. A particle filter propagated by radar odometry proposes candidate poses, and our observation model provides a likelihood over these poses. We evaluate our method over 31 distinct routes, over 8 datasets spanning both urban and offroad conditions using only ground radar and a coarse local prior. We also examine the robustness over changing weather using repeated traversals over the same route over 13 months, in both urban and offroad conditions.

摘要（中文）：中文翻译： 在实时自主现场应用中，GNSS往往不可靠且不精确。一种可行的解决方案是借助预先构建的地图（如卫星图像）进行定位，因为这类地图已具备地理参照且经过测绘。在本研究中，我们利用学习得到的观测模型，将旋转雷达测量数据与俯视RGB图像进行配准。我们采用通过掩码重建预训练的雷达表征，并将其与卫星图像特征进行对齐。由雷达里程计传播的粒子滤波器提出候选位姿，我们的观测模型为这些位姿提供似然估计。我们在覆盖城市与越野条件的8个数据集上的31条不同路线上评估了该方法，仅使用地面雷达和粗略的局部先验信息。此外，我们还通过对同一路线在13个月内多次重复穿越的数据，考察了该方法在天气变化下的鲁棒性，涵盖城市与越野环境。

Authors: Shaunak Kolhe, Peng Jiang, Kasi Viswanath, Srikanth Saripalli

On Maximum Clique and Maximum Consensus Formulations in Point Cloud Registration Perception3D

point cloud registration maximum clique maximum consensus robust matching geometric error bounds

简要说明：本文从理论上分析了鲁棒点云配准中最大团与最大一致性公式之间的关系，推导了误差界限和几何条件，并对机器人技术具有启示意义。

TLDR: This paper theoretically analyzes the relationship between maximum clique and maximum consensus formulations for robust point cloud registration, deriving error bounds and geometric conditions, with implications for robotics.

Abstract: Maximum clique and maximum consensus are widely used formulations for robust point cloud registration in robotics. Maximum consensus seeks one transformation that aligns as many matches as possible, while maximum clique selects matches through pairwise distance tests. Maximum clique is often used as a substitute for or an approximation to maximum consensus, with empirical evidence suggesting a close relationship. However, how closely the two formulations agree is not fully understood. We study this relationship theoretically. We show that a maximum clique can have arbitrarily large alignment error and be arbitrarily larger than the maximum consensus set at any fixed positive tolerance, and derive geometric conditions that bound this error. When rotation is fixed, we derive sharp error bounds and tests that exactly characterize maximum consensus for the translation subproblem. Finally, we study group-$k$ consistency, which tests groups of $k$ matches, and determine the smallest group sizes that guarantee alignment error bounds independent of point cloud scale and geometry. These are $d+1$ for rotations and translations and $d+2$ when reflections are allowed, in dimensions $d\ge 2$. Interactive examples and proof verification using the Lean theorem prover are available at https://ariarobotics.github.io/mc-vs-mc-registration/.

摘要（中文）：最大团与最大共识是机器人领域点云稳健配准中广泛使用的两种建模方法。最大共识旨在寻找一个变换，使尽可能多的匹配点对齐；而最大团则通过成对距离检验来筛选匹配点。最大团常被用作最大共识的替代或近似方法，已有经验证据表明二者关系密切。然而，这两种建模方法之间的一致性程度尚不完全清楚。我们从理论上研究了这一关系。我们证明，在任意固定正容忍度下，最大团的对齐误差可能任意大，且其规模可能任意大于最大共识集；同时，我们推导了约束该误差的几何条件。当旋转固定时，我们给出了精确的误差界，并提出了能够精确刻画平移子问题中最大共识的检验条件。最后，我们研究了组\(k\)一致性——即对\(k\)个匹配点组成的组进行检验，并确定了保证对齐误差界不依赖于点云尺度与几何结构的最小分组大小。在维度\(d \ge 2\)下，该最小分组大小在旋转和平移情形下为\(d+1\)，在允许反射的情形下为\(d+2\)。交互式示例及基于Lean定理证明器的验证可参见 https://ariarobotics.github.io/mc-vs-mc-registration/。

Which Depth Estimator for Jetson AGX Orin? A 2026 Benchmark of Monocular and Stereo Methods Perception3D

简要说明：本文对Jetson AGX Orin嵌入式计算机上的单目和立体深度估计器进行了全面基准测试，评估了精度、速度和能耗，发现立体方法明显比单目方法更准确。

TLDR: This paper provides a comprehensive benchmark of monocular and stereo depth estimators on the Jetson AGX Orin embedded computer, evaluating accuracy, speed, and energy consumption for robotics and vehicle applications, and finding that stereo methods are significantly more accurate than monocular ones.

Abstract: The Jetson AGX Orin is a common computer for robots and vehicles, yet measured accuracy, speed and energy of current depth estimators on it are hard to find. We benchmark nine model families as of October 2026: the monocular Depth Anything V2 and 3, Depth Pro, MoGe-2, Metric3D v2 and UniDepth V2, and the stereo methods libSGM, NVIDIA ESS and Fast-FoundationStereo. Every method runs on the Orin as a TensorRT FP16 engine or native CUDA code at up to three input sizes, up to the full 5.7 MP, and is scored for metric accuracy against Middlebury 2014 ground truth (non-occluded pixels of the 10 scenes whose disparity stays below 256 px), GPU time, energy and licence. Stereo is far more accurate. At 30 fps, NVIDIA's ESS reaches 0.70% AbsRel in 8.6 ms and libSGM 0.73% in 25 ms; with more compute, Fast-FoundationStereo reaches 0.33%. The best monocular models reach 12% with the true focal length (Depth Anything 3 Metric-L in 33 ms, Depth Pro in 803 ms), and 3.8-4.0% only with an oracle per-image scale (MoGe-2-L, UniDepth V2-B, Metric3D v2-L). Stereo error falls as the input resolution grows; no monocular model improves, and the metric scale of most drifts away from the truth outside their training resolution. At depth discontinuities, which AbsRel barely registers, the monocular models scatter 17-46% of the edge points between foreground and background, learned stereo 2-9% and libSGM at full resolution 1%. We give recommendations per frame-rate budget and release all code, per-scene results and engine build scripts.

摘要（中文）：捷森AGX Orin是机器人和车辆常用的计算平台，然而目前关于其上的深度估计器的实测精度、速度和能耗数据却难以获取。我们于2026年10月对九个模型家族进行了基准测试，包括单目方法Depth Anything V2和V3、Depth Pro、MoGe-2、Metric3D v2和UniDepth V2，以及立体匹配方法libSGM、NVIDIA ESS和Fast-FoundationStereo。每种方法均在Orin平台上以TensorRT FP16引擎或原生CUDA代码运行，输入尺寸最高可达三种规格，最大至全分辨率5.7 MP，并依据Middlebury 2014真值（视差低于256像素的10个场景的非遮挡像素）对度量精度、GPU运行时间、能耗和许可证条件进行评分。立体匹配方法精度远高于单目方法。在30帧每秒的条件下，NVIDIA的ESS在8.6毫秒内达到0.70%的绝对相对误差（AbsRel），libSGM在25毫秒内达到0.73%；若投入更多计算资源，Fast-FoundationStereo可达到0.33%。最佳单目模型在使用真实焦距时达到约12%的误差（Depth Anything 3 Metric-L耗时33毫秒，Depth Pro耗时803毫秒），而仅在利用逐图像真值尺度（oracle scale）的情况下才能达到3.8%–4.0%的误差（MoGe-2-L、UniDepth V2-B、Metric3D v2-L）。立体匹配误差随输入分辨率增大而下降；单目模型则无此改善，且大多数模型在超出其训练分辨率时，度量尺度会偏离真实值。在深度不连续区域（AbsRel几乎无法反映），单目模型将17%–46%的边缘点散布在前景与背景之间，学习型立体方法为2%–9%，而全分辨率下的libSGM仅为1%。我们针对不同帧率预算给出推荐方案，并公开全部代码、逐场景结果及引擎构建脚本。

Authors: Leaf Jiang

Learning to Be Different: Component Specialization for Compositional Diffusion Policies Manipulation

diffusion policies compositional generalization score-decorrelation multitask robotic learning specialization

简要说明：本文为组合扩散策略提出了一种分数去相关的辅助损失，以促进组件特化并减少重复计数，同时不影响多任务性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces a score-decorrelation auxiliary loss for compositional diffusion policies in robotic multitask learning, promoting component specialization and reducing double-counting without compromising performance.

Abstract: Diffusion policies with linearly composed scores have emerged as a promising approach to multitask robotic learning by combining separate factors to enable modular, task-wise adaptation, compositional generalization, and interpretable functional decomposition. However, current training objectives do not encourage factor specialization, often resulting in uninterpretable denoisers whose composed prediction is an average over identical copies, undermining their architectural premise. To address this, we propose a drop-in score-decorrelation auxiliary loss, motivated by projective composition theory. Our approach encourages specialization by penalizing overlap directly between component noise predictions, with little architectural change or computational overhead. We demonstrate across multiple benchmarks that our decorrelation loss consistently reduces measurable double-counting between components, improves task decomposition, and produces behaviorally meaningful specialization without compromising multitask performance. Website: https://al3cl1.github.io/robotics-score-decorrelation.

摘要（中文）：扩散策略与线性组合得分相结合，已逐渐成为多任务机器人学习的一种有前景的方法，通过结合不同因素实现模块化、任务级适应、组合泛化以及可解释的功能分解。然而，当前的训练目标并不鼓励因子特化，常常导致去噪器难以解释，其组合预测不过是对相同副本的平均，从而削弱了其架构前提。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种即插即用的得分去相关辅助损失函数，其设计基于投影组合理论。我们的方法通过直接惩罚组件噪声预测之间的重叠来鼓励特化，几乎不引入架构改动或计算开销。我们在多个基准测试中证明，所提出的去相关损失能持续减少组件间可测量的重复计数，改善任务分解，并产生行为上有意义的特化，且不损害多任务性能。网站：https://al3cl1.github.io/robotics-score-decorrelation。

Authors: Alec Laprevotte, Haonan Chen, Xiaoshen Han, Yilun Du

Visual Task Modeling and Automated Planning for Humanoid Robots in Education of Individuals with Autism Spectrum Disorder HumanoidEmbodied

Vision-based LLM PDDL planning Humanoid robot Shoebox Tasks Autism Spectrum Disorder

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于视觉LLM的求解器，可将Shoebox任务照片转换为PDDL计划，使Nao机器人在自闭症谱系障碍教育中半自主执行任务并辅助学生。

TLDR: This paper introduces a vision-based LLM solver that converts photos of Shoebox Tasks into PDDL plans for a Nao robot to assist in educating children with ASD, enabling semi-autonomous task execution and student guidance.

Abstract: In robot-assisted education, a robot must understand how to complete a task in order to effectively guide a student through it. We present a novel method that enables a semi-autonomous, camera-equipped robot to recognise the task goal and plan actions to achieve it. Our work focuses on Shoebox Tasks, an activity commonly used in the education of individuals with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD). These tasks are designed so that the goal can be inferred directly from their visual structure. We have developed a solver that uses a vision-based Large Language Model to convert photos of a Shoebox Task into a Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL) representation and generate action plans for solving it. We have also implemented a robotic interface that enables a Nao robot to autonomously execute various Shoebox Tasks and assist a student by suggesting next steps or signalling detected failures through action demonstrations, voice commands, or gestures. With an adapted robotic interface, the solver can be integrated into a variety of educational robots. No programming expertise is required from teachers, and the solver operates exclusively on captured images as input. Research in special educational needs indicates that students with ASD can benefit substantially from robot-assisted teaching, and our system aims to strengthen these learning opportunities while also fostering interest in robotics among individuals with ASD.

摘要（中文）：在机器人辅助教育中，机器人必须理解如何完成一项任务，才能有效地引导学生完成该任务。我们提出了一种新颖的方法，使配备摄像头的半自主机器人能够识别任务目标并规划实现该目标的动作。我们的工作聚焦于鞋盒任务，这是一种常用于自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）个体教育的活动。这些任务的设计使得目标可以直接从其视觉结构中推断出来。我们开发了一个求解器，利用基于视觉的大型语言模型将鞋盒任务的照片转换为规划领域定义语言（PDDL）表示，并生成解决该任务的动作计划。我们还实现了一个机器人接口，使Nao机器人能够自主执行各种鞋盒任务，并通过动作演示、语音指令或手势建议下一步操作或提示检测到的失败。通过适配的机器人接口，该求解器可以集成到多种教育机器人中。教师无需具备编程专业知识，且该求解器仅以捕获的图像作为输入。特殊教育需求领域的研究表明，自闭症谱系障碍学生可以从机器人辅助教学中显著受益，而我们的系统旨在加强这些学习机会，同时激发自闭症谱系障碍个体对机器人技术的兴趣。

Authors: Lada Kudláčková

Learning Computational Structure for Sample-Efficient Prediction WorldModel

learned wiring sample efficiency compositional sparsity world-model prediction connectivity learning

简要说明：本文提出LeWi方法，通过低维嵌入联合学习网络连接与权重，在组合稀疏目标和涉及控制、导航、操作的世界模型预测任务上提升了样本效率。

TLDR: This paper introduces LeWi, a method that learns neural network connectivity alongside weights via low-dimensional embeddings, improving sample efficiency on compositionally sparse targets and world-model prediction tasks in control, navigation, and manipulation.

Abstract: Statistical learning in high dimensions suffers from the curse of dimensionality. Fortunately, many functions of practical interest are compositionally sparse, meaning they admit a composition of local functions, each depending on only a few variables, allowing sample complexity to depend on local arity rather than ambient dimension. Yet realizing this benefit requires exploiting hidden compositional structure, which theory does not establish for practical gradient-based training. We study this gap with CSFRBench, a controlled benchmark that hides the target's compositional computation during training but retains it for diagnosis, and find that dense networks and sparsity-based baselines leave much of that benefit unrealized. Inspired by the spatial organization of biological neural circuits, we introduce Learned Wiring (LeWi): each neuron has a learned low-dimensional embedding, only nearby neurons connect, and embeddings and weights are trained jointly. LeWi improves sample efficiency on targets with hierarchical structure, intermediate reuse, or independent modules. Across 32 additional targets generated by independently sampled computation graphs, LeWi is the most sample-efficient method not given the target graph, with 27% lower mean learning-curve area than dense networks. Dense networks perform better on targets with a single high-arity function. LeWi's representations and connectivity align with the target computation. On 17 world-model prediction tasks spanning control, navigation, and manipulation, LeWi beats the dense baseline on 16 and wins 99/119 baseline comparisons. These results show that jointly learning connectivity and weights can exploit computational structure to improve sample efficiency.

摘要（中文）：高维统计学习面临着维度灾难的挑战。幸运的是，许多实际感兴趣的函数具有组合稀疏性，即它们可以表示为若干局部函数的组合，每个局部函数仅依赖少量变量，这使得样本复杂度可以取决于局部元数而非环境维度。然而，要发挥这一优势，需要挖掘隐藏的组合结构，而现有理论并未证明实用的基于梯度的训练方法能够做到这一点。我们通过CSFRBench这一受控基准来研究这一差距——该基准在训练过程中隐藏目标函数的组合计算方式，但保留其用于诊断分析。研究发现，稠密网络和基于稀疏性的基线方法在很大程度上未能实现上述优势。受生物神经回路空间组织的启发，我们提出了学习式连接（LeWi）方法：每个神经元具有一个可学习的低维嵌入，仅邻近神经元之间建立连接，且嵌入和权重联合训练。LeWi在具有层级结构、中间结果复用或独立模块的目标函数上显著提升了样本效率。在由独立采样的计算图生成的32个额外目标函数上，LeWi是在未提供目标图的方法中样本效率最高的，其平均学习曲线面积比稠密网络低27%。稠密网络在具有单一高元数函数的目标上表现更优。LeWi的表征和连接结构与目标计算过程高度对齐。在涵盖控制、导航和操作任务的17个世界模型预测任务中，LeWi在16个任务上优于稠密基线，并在99/119次基线对比中胜出。这些结果表明，联合学习连接结构和权重能够利用计算结构提升样本效率。

Authors: Hangyu Zhou, Constantine Dovrolis, Stephen Mussmann

OverSeer: Multi-Agent World Models Beyond What Agents See WorldModel

multi-agent world model video generation auxiliary camera views delta-VAE consistency

简要说明：OverSeer 提出了一种多智能体世界模型，利用固定的辅助摄像机视角作为世界中心的代理，以提高生成视频流在智能体之间和时间上的一致性，并通过 delta-VAE 实现高效压缩，在 Minecraft、Doom 和真实世界数据上得到验证。

TLDR: OverSeer introduces a multi-agent world model that uses fixed auxiliary camera views as a world-centric proxy to improve cross-agent and temporal consistency in generated video streams, with a delta-VAE for efficient compression, demonstrated in Minecraft, Doom, and real-world captures.

Abstract: Despite the success of video world models, extending them to multiple agents is difficult because it requires generating several agent-specific video streams that are consistent in time and between agents. To address this gap, we introduce OverSeer, a multi-agent world model that augments egocentric agent views with auxiliary camera views. We suggest that, by fixing the auxiliary views in space, they act as a proxy for a world-centric representation: Unlike the agents' views, which can change entirely due to a simple change in agent position, changes in the auxiliary views directly map to localized changes in the world state. We show that these fixed views substantially help the model to maintain consistency. We also show that, due to their redundant and semi-static nature, the auxiliary views can be efficiently compressed with a delta-VAE that encodes only the changes relative to a static reference image, reducing the number of tokens required to process them. Experiments in Minecraft and Doom demonstrate improved world and agent consistency, with qualitative results on real-world multi-camera captures indicating that the approach is not tied to game engines. Our compression analysis further shows that delta-VAE substantially reduces the computational overhead of auxiliary-view generation. We conclude that these fixed views provide a simple and efficient way to improve multi-agent world models.

摘要（中文）：尽管视频世界模型已取得显著成功，将其扩展到多智能体场景仍面临挑战，原因在于需生成多个智能体专属视频流，并确保其在时间及智能体间的一致性。为填补这一空白，我们提出了OverSeer，一种多智能体世界模型，通过为智能体第一视角补充辅助相机视角来增强建模能力。我们主张，将这些辅助视角固定在空间中，可使其充当世界中心表示的代理：与智能体视角不同——智能体位置的简单变化即可导致视角彻底改变——辅助视角的变化直接映射到世界状态的局部变化。实验表明，这些固定视角极大地帮助模型维持一致性。同时，由于辅助视角具有冗余及半静态特性，可借助增量变分自编码器（delta-VAE）对其进行高效压缩，该编码器仅编码相对静态参考图像的变化部分，从而减少了处理所需token数量。在Minecraft和Doom中的实验验证了改进后的世界及智能体一致性，而对现实世界多相机捕捉数据的定性结果表明，该方法并不局限于游戏引擎。我们的压缩分析进一步显示，delta-VAE显著降低了辅助视角生成的计算开销。综上，固定视角为提升多智能体世界模型提供了一种简单且高效的途径。

Authors: Runjia Li, Kam Woh Ng, Minghao Chen, Junlin Han, Jianyuan Wang, Zhaochong An, Juan-Manuel Perez-Rua, Andrea Vedaldi, Shikun Liu

Deep Learning-Based Road Lane Quality Assessment from Egocentric Dashcam Video AutonomousDriving

dashcam dataset lane-marking quality no-reference metrics Hough-line weak supervision

简要说明：该论文提出了一个地理参考的行车记录仪数据集和基线框架，用于评估车道标线质量，使用无参考指标（CSI、LCR、RLCS），适用于人类驾驶员和自动驾驶系统。

TLDR: This paper introduces a geo-referenced dashcam dataset and baseline framework for assessing lane-marking quality using no-reference metrics (CSI, LCR, RLCS), with applications for both human drivers and automated driving systems.

Abstract: Reliable lane markings are important for both human drivers and automated driving systems, but their condition is still commonly assessed through manual inspection. Existing autonomous-driving datasets primarily support lane detection and scene understanding and usually lack maintenance-oriented labels for lane-marking visibility, continuity, or degradation. In this study, we present a geo-referenced smartphone dashcam dataset and baseline framework for lane-marking quality assessment. The dataset contains 63,839 road-facing frames collected across South Texas using a GPS-enabled dashcam application. A subset of 3,339 frames is matched with OpenStreetMap-derived lane-count labels, which are used as weak supervision for lane-count regression and map-consistency evaluation. We propose three lane-quality measures: Contrast Stability Index (CSI), which captures lane-background contrast using Laplacian responses; Line Continuity Ratio (LCR), which estimates structural continuity using edge and Hough-line evidence; and Regression Lane Confidence Score (RLCS), which measures agreement between predicted and map-derived lane counts on matched frames. The baseline prediction models attained strong performance, with CSI (MAE $0.039$, $R^2=0.97$) and LCR (MAE $0.093$, $R^2=0.84$). Notably, CSI and LCR are no-reference, segmentation-derived quality metrics that can be computed without dense human labels. In a pilot validation using 50 human-ranked images, these proposed lane-specific metrics show stronger rank agreement with human lane-quality ordering (e.g., Spearman's $ρ=0.7316$ and Kendall's $τ=0.5472$ for LCR) than general image-quality measures such as PSNR, SSIM, BRISQUE, NIQE, and LPIPS. We believe the dataset, metrics, and baseline provide an initial step toward scalable, low-cost, location-aware lane-marking quality assessment. Data and code: https://github.com/Shaif95/Road_Quality

摘要（中文）：可靠的车道标线对于人类驾驶员和自动驾驶系统都至关重要，但其状况目前仍通常依靠人工检查来评估。现有的自动驾驶数据集主要支持车道检测和场景理解，往往缺乏面向养护的车道标线可见性、连续性或退化程度标签。本研究提出了一个地理参考的智能手机行车记录仪数据集及车道标线质量评估的基线框架。该数据集包含使用支持GPS的行车记录仪应用在南得克萨斯州采集的63,839帧路面图像。其中3,339帧图像与从OpenStreetMap提取的车道数量标签进行匹配，这些标签用作车道数量回归和地图一致性评估的弱监督信息。我们提出了三个车道质量度量指标：对比度稳定性指数（CSI），利用拉普拉斯响应捕捉车道与背景的对比度；线条连续性比率（LCR），利用边缘和霍夫线证据估计结构连续性；以及回归车道置信度评分（RLCS），用于衡量匹配帧上预测车道数量与地图来源车道数量之间的一致性。基线预测模型取得了较强性能，其中CSI（MAE $0.039$，$R^2=0.97$）和LCR（MAE $0.093$，$R^2=0.84$）。值得注意的是，CSI和LCR是无参考、基于分割的质量度量指标，无需密集的人工标注即可计算。在使用50张人工排序图像进行的初步验证中，这些提出的车道专用指标与人类车道质量排序的秩相关性更强（例如，LCR的Spearman's $ρ=0.7316$，Kendall's $τ=0.5472$），优于PSNR、SSIM、BRISQUE、NIQE和LPIPS等通用图像质量指标。我们相信，该数据集、度量指标和基线框架为可扩展、低成本、位置感知的车道标线质量评估迈出了初步一步。数据和代码：https://github.com/Shaif95/Road_Quality
